description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:263 has `[`discover_crl_signer`]` with no path qualifier and no corresponding link reference. rustdoc emits broken_intra_doc_links warning: 'unresolved link to discover_crl_signer'. RFC 5280 §6.3.3(f) doc references the function but the link target is unresolved. Trigger: `cargo doc -p pkix-revocation --all-features`. Bad behavior: rustdoc emits W-broken-intra-doc-links; docs.rs build (with RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' on nightly) would fail. Fix: change to `[`discover_crl_signer`][crate::discover_crl_signer]` or add a link reference at module scope (the pattern used elsewhere in this file).
title: Broken intra-doc link to discover_crl_signer in crl.rs:263
